notes: All required story sections are present.
Community Origin is optional and correctly omitted.
No unfilled template variables, TBD markers or TODO markers remain.
Dev Agent Record and QA Results are reserved for their later lifecycle stages.
Executor and quality gate are distinct.
The assignment matches the UI, responsive integration and basic accessibility work defined by the epic.
Every acceptance criterion maps to one or more explicit implementation or validation tasks.
The story covers the complete task lifecycle, gamification summary, feedback, persistence states, responsiveness and keyboard operation.
The 18 PRD acceptance criteria are assigned to an integrated evidence matrix in docs/TESTS.md.
The story preserves the approved acyclic module graph and the boundaries between domain, persistence, coordination and DOM rendering.
Gamification remains derived by domain.js, LocalStorage access remains isolated in storage.js and ui.js is limited to simple DOM functions.
The solution remains a single responsive page using native HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES Modules and LocalStorage.
No framework, bundler, backend, remote database, authentication, external API or production dependency is introduced.
Semantic page structure, normal and editing task states, empty state, contextual errors, persistent storage warning and announcement region are specified.
Mobile-first behavior, safe text wrapping, visible focus, keyboard operation and post-deletion focus recovery have explicit tasks.
Native confirmation is proportionate to the academic MVP and avoids an unnecessary custom modal.
The story preserves the 39 automated tests and requires all five project quality commands.
Manual browser validation is explicitly documented for CA-01 through CA-18, including desktop, mobile, keyboard, focus, persistence and XP boundaries.
DOM automation, E2E, visual regression and deep screen-reader testing remain optional unless implementation risk justifies them.
User task text must be inserted through textual DOM APIs and never interpreted as HTML.
No credentials, network transmission, alternate storage or external service is introduced.
Invalid local data and LocalStorage failures are mapped to safe states and user-facing messages without leaking exception details.
The project does not enable CodeRabbit in core-config.yaml and the required disabled notice is present.
Manual review by the configured quality gate is the fallback.
